data.description_html:
What to Build

You must create a project in one of two tracks and in one of the subject categories:

  • Coding Track: Build a functional prototype, app, website, simulation, or other coded solution. Citations and evidence in your project description is a bonus!

  • Research Track: Conduct background research and create a literature review, theoretical framework, or experimental design around your chosen problem. A prototype is a bonus!

What to Submit

Project Video (Required) (Paste link in Video demo link field)

  • Maximum 4 minutes in length.
  • Must explain the problem, your solution, and how it works.
  • Can include demo footage, slides, or other visuals.

Written Project Description (Required) (About the project field)

  • Provide a detailed description of your idea/solution, including what makes it innovative.
  • Coding Track → include description of technologies used.
  • Research Track → include background research and references (if applicable).

Code or Research Documentation (Required)

  • Coding Track (Try it out links):
    • PUBLIC GitHub or other repo link (Required) with source code, with a README explaining setup/use.
    • Live Demo (testable link) - recommended but not required
  • Research Track (File upload):
    • Participants will submit a PDF containing the following sections: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Y7UJF9GO88y6imqEjcE2kyPyv6QwieMmWFFdpY8GVAM/edit?usp=sharing

NOTES:

  • Projects created before the hackathon timeframe are permitted, however they will receive a harsh point deducton.
  • AI use for writing code/research document is discouraged, but allowed. AI use for ideation and support is encouraged. Just know that quality is a judging criteria!
